headline: 4 killed as lorry hits microbus returning from wedding in Chittagong
summary: The victims include the bride's siblings. At least 11 others were injured in the head-on collision on the Chittagong-Cox's Bazar highway.
details: Four people were killed in a head-on collision between a covered van and a microbus in the Karnaphuli area of Chittagong.
The accident occurred around 1:30 AM on Saturday (September 12) at the Shikolbaha Choumuhani area of the Chittagong-Cox's Bazar highway.
The microbus was carrying passengers returning to Cox's Bazar Eidgah after attending a wedding ceremony in Agrabad.
Police reported that the collision happened when a covered van taking a U-turn collided head-on with the microbus.
Two people died on the spot, while two others passed away while receiving treatment at Chittagong Medical College Hospital.
Among the deceased are the siblings of the bride. At least 11 other passengers were injured, with some reported to be in critical condition.
Police have seized the covered van, but the driver and assistant have fled the scene. An operation is underway to arrest them.
caption:

Four people were killed in a head-on collision between a covered van and a microbus in the Karnaphuli area of Chittagong.

The accident occurred around 1:30 AM on Saturday (September 12) at the Shikolbaha Choumuhani area of the Chittagong-Cox's Bazar highway.

The microbus was carrying passengers returning to Cox's Bazar Eidgah after attending a wedding ceremony in Agrabad.

Police reported that the collision happened when a covered van taking a U-turn collided head-on with the microbus.

Two people died on the spot, while two others passed away while receiving treatment at Chittagong Medical College Hospital.

Among the deceased are the siblings of the bride. At least 11 other passengers were injured, with some reported to be in critical condition.

Police have seized the covered van, but the driver and assistant have fled the scene. An operation is underway to arrest them.

headline_marked: [[Bangladeshi man killed]] after being shot by BSF along Thakurgaon border
headline: Bangladeshi man killed after being shot by BSF along Thakurgaon border
summary: Asadul Haque, 38, died in a hospital in West Bengal after BSF personnel opened fire on a group of suspected smugglers.
details: A 38-year-old Bangladeshi man, identified as Asadul Haque, has died after being shot by India's Border Security Force (BSF) in Thakurgaon's Pirganj upazila.
The incident occurred around 1:30 am yesterday when BSF personnel from the Chakshibananda camp opened fire on a group of suspected smugglers 1.5km inside Indian territory.
Asadul was injured in the firing and was taken to a hospital in Raiganj, West Bengal, where he later succumbed to his injuries.
According to a press release from the Dinajpur 42 BGB Battalion, Asadul was an identified drug smuggler and was also involved in human trafficking.
The BGB stated that several cases had been filed against him at the Pirganj Police Station regarding these activities.
Lt Col Abdullah Al Moin Hasan, commanding officer of BGB 42 Battalion, noted that the BSF has not yet officially informed them of the death.
The BGB has called for a flag meeting with the BSF today to discuss the incident and gather more details.
caption:

Asadul was injured in the firing and was taken to a hospital in Raiganj, West Bengal, where he later succumbed to his injuries.

According to a press release from the Dinajpur 42 BGB Battalion, Asadul was an identified drug smuggler and was also involved in human trafficking.

The BGB stated that several cases had been filed against him at the Pirganj Police Station regarding these activities.

Lt Col Abdullah Al Moin Hasan, commanding officer of BGB 42 Battalion, noted that the BSF has not yet officially informed them of the death.

The BGB has called for a flag meeting with the BSF today to discuss the incident and gather more details.
